OVERREACH: No causal claims. Just descriptive count. So fine.

The code didn't check for any inconsistencies in sample_seq beyond max >1. Could there be patients with sample_seq not monotonic? Not needed. No problem.

FALSE PREMISE: Premises are verified by code: duplicate rows exist, patient_id identifies, higher sample_seq kept. So no false premise.

Thus answer is sound. Verdict accept, no issues.
